prompt: grafana-operator route tls passthrough termination restriction
answer:
For a Grafana Operator OpenShift Route using TLS passthrough:

- Passthrough sends traffic directly to the destination without router TLS termination.
- Passthrough does **not support paths**; the generated Route must use an empty path.
- `spec.tls.termination: passthrough` cannot be combined with `spec.tls.insecureEdgeTerminationPolicy: Allow`.
- The operator fixed this by returning an empty path for passthrough Routes.

Sources: [API reference](https://grafana.github.io/grafana-operator/docs/api), [Issue #766](https://github.com/grafana/grafana-operator/issues/766), [PR #773](https://github.com/grafana/grafana-operator/pull/773)
